packageRules.description: Hold TypeScript on v6 until the ecosystem supports the native (Go) compiler's JS API. TS 7's `typescript` module ships only `version`/`versionMajorMinor`, so tools that consume the programmatic compiler API break: tsup/rollup-plugin-dts (@beaket/paper d.ts build), react-docgen-typescript (docs prop tables + Storybook docgen), and @volar/kit/astro-check (docs typecheck). No TS-7-compatible releases of these are published yet.
